args.name: Emergency food search with empty-source rechecking
args.function: Find and collect reachable known-safe food during a starvation emergency, including physically rechecking previously empty sources when appropriate. Reuse bounded-resource-search-recheck if suitable.
args.conditions: At tick 151 my health is 36, satiety 0 and energy 8.85 before eating my one owned berry. Nearby observed berry plants are empty. Ordinary bounded-resource-search stops at health <=60 or satiety <=8, so it cannot address this emergency. Berry nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 are known.
args.inputs: Known berry sources, current observations, actual position, available energy, and explicit short distance and time limits.
args.costs: Unknown additional method or learning costs; retain real movement, inspection and gathering costs. Do not assume food exists or that depleted plants have replenished.
args.effects: Provide a feasible emergency search capability or identify an existing equivalent, with explicit safety limits and actual collection only from available sources. No invented supplies, healing, replenishment or guaranteed success.

execution.progress: start or resume continues with the same action, one step per round, until it completes or stops; a round taken by another action pauses it. Steps and costs stay.

details.costs: None of its own: each round is one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and load, at most 0.8 per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the reserve; one that does not fit is not taken. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
details.effects: Without lowHealth: exactly bounded-resource-search-recheck (minHealth 60 to 100). lowHealth: true: health at or below minHealth (default 20, 20 to 100) stops it instead of health 60, and satiety <= 8 or starvation damage alone does not; any other injury in the last round, body temperature 12 or below or 32 or above, minTemp, maxTemp, the reserve and every limit still do. radius, path, time, energy and quantity must be above 0. A food search needs reserve >= 1 and your own eating record of that food as edible and nontoxic. Ripe sources seen now or remembered in the radius first, nearest first; with recheck, then sources last seen empty, each probed at most once per run; a remembered place is only a navigate destination. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created, eaten or healed; no reward; food is not assured.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

retrieval.access: Search/index only; omission is not absence. Use exact ids and zero-based offset/part for full records. No physical observation, state change or reward is performed.
